label: FOLLOW-UP on previously analysed P4 development data; not a fresh test set

inputs.predictions: layer_sweep/v1/p4_predictions.npz (saved; esm_L26 = layer-26 ESM-only probe, comp_L26 = composition baseline)
inputs.annotation_status: discovery_analysis/v1/inclusion_manifest.tsv, column signal_status (UniProt signal-peptide annotation for the frozen sequence)
inputs.clusters: cluster array saved in p4_predictions.npz (30% identity MMseqs2 clusters)

population: all 2,366 core P4 proteins; P0 not accessed; no refitting, no extraction

groups.annotated_present: UniProt records a signal peptide for the frozen sequence
groups.not_annotated: a matching UniProt record carries no signal-peptide annotation; biological presence is UNKNOWN, not confirmed absent
groups.unverifiable: kept separate; excluded from the primary estimate; count reported; never pooled with not_annotated

primary.definition: pair-weighted mean of within-group AUROCs over annotated_present and not_annotated; only extracellular-cytoplasmic pairs from the SAME group contribute

bootstrap.unit: 30% identity cluster across all of P4, drawn whole with replacement

sparse_flag: a group is flagged SPARSE if either class has fewer than 30 proteins or fewer than 20 distinct clusters
unverifiable_reporting: counts by class only; AUROCs shown descriptively if both classes present, never in the primary
